sources.articleTitle: Japan great 'King Kazu' Miura sets oldest appearance record at 59

headline: Kazuyoshi Miura Sets New Record As Oldest Professional Athlete
seoTitle: Kazuyoshi Miura Sets Record As Oldest Professional Player
metaDescription: Japanese football player Kazuyoshi Miura has set a new record as the oldest professional to appear in a match at the age of 59.
aiSummaryBullets: Footballer Kazuyoshi Miura has broken the record for the oldest professional player to compete in a match.
The athlete achieved this milestone at the age of 59.
The veteran player is widely known by the nickname King Kazu within the sporting community.
aiContextParagraph: Kazuyoshi Miura, a veteran Japanese professional football player, has officially set a new record for the oldest player to appear in a competitive professional match. At the age of 59, Miura continues his long-standing career in the sport, reaching a milestone that has drawn international attention from the football world. Frequently referred to as King Kazu by fans and media, Miura remains a prominent figure in Japanese athletics due to his exceptional career longevity. His recent participation in a match confirms his ongoing role as a professional competitor, extending a legacy that has spanned several decades. While younger athletes typically retire in their thirties or early forties, Miura's continued involvement highlights his endurance and commitment to professional football, establishing a new benchmark in the history of the sport for active participants at this age.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to significant public search interest in Japan and the notable nature of a professional athlete competing at age 59.
